Notes on what backs this pick: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre's own program page describes a class for 
"18 months - 3 years" that "is for the toddler who loves to be on the move" and "involves parent participation and is led by a coach through a structured warm-up, games, music, and circuits on all gymnastic events"
. The same page gives the fall dates as 
"Fall Session : Sept 10 - Dec 16 (no classes Oct 10)"
.

I could not pin down a firm price or registration-open date for this specific toddler class — the site shows conflicting figures elsewhere (one page says registration for the fall term begins July 20th, another lists a February 21st date tied to the same schedule block), so I left both out rather than guess.
